granite.name: Granite
granite.cue: Broad gray faces with pale stone chips.

copper.name: Copper-flecked rock
copper.cue: Thick copper seams are a strong clue.

tin.name: Tin-flecked rock
tin.cue: Pale blue stone holds thin, silver-white plates.

iron.name: Iron-flecked rock
iron.cue: Heavy, dark steel bands suggest iron.

crystal.name: Crystalline rock
crystal.cue: Deep-set facets suggest a chance of a gem.

false-glint.name: False ore glint
false-glint.cue: Small metallic-looking patches give a weaker clue than a deep seam.

shiny-surface.name: Shiny surface
shiny-surface.cue: Broad flashes follow the surface of the stone.

crystal-shell.name: Crystal-like shell
crystal-shell.cue: Shallow facets coat the outside of the stone.
